test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Choose the correctly spelt word from the given options.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. Fascination .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **Fascination** refers to the state of being fascinated or attracted to something strongly.
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **Fascination**.
 
• Option 1 (**Fasination**) and Option 2 (**Fascinacion**) are incorrect because they are misspelled versions of the word.

Correct word: *Fascination*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Root Word:** The word originates from the Latin root "fascinare," meaning to captivate or bewitch.
 
• **Usage in a Sentence:** Her fascination with astronomy led her to pursue a career in space science.
